definitions.explanation: Lacking compassion or mercy; showing no pity. Used to describe people, actions, or abstract forces (like fate or nature) that are unforgiving. Composed of 無 (without) + 慈悲 (mercy/compassion).

examples.japanese: {無慈悲|むじひ}な{仕打|しう}ちに{耐|た}えた。
{自然|しぜん}{災害|さいがい}は{無慈悲|むじひ}に{人々|ひとびと}の{生活|せいかつ}を{奪|うば}う。
examples.english: Natural disasters mercilessly rob people of their livelihoods.

examples.japanese: {戦争|せんそう}の{無慈悲|むじひ}な{現実|げんじつ}を{伝|つた}えるドキュメンタリーが{放送|ほうそう}された。
examples.english: A documentary conveying the merciless reality of war was broadcast.

notes:
USAGE:
{無慈悲|むじひ} is a na-adjective: {無慈悲|むじひ}な (attributive) and {無慈悲|むじひ}に (adverbial). It is a literary or formal word, more commonly found in writing, news, and dramatic contexts than in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無慈悲|むじひ}な{攻撃|こうげき} (merciless attack)
- {無慈悲|むじひ}な{仕打|しう}ち (cruel treatment)
- {無慈悲|むじひ}に{切|き}り{捨|す}てる (ruthlessly discard)
- {無慈悲|むじひ}な{現実|げんじつ} (merciless reality)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{冷酷|れいこく} means "cold-hearted" or "ruthless" with an emphasis on emotional coldness. {残酷|ざんこく} means "cruel" or "brutal" and emphasizes the infliction of suffering. {非情|ひじょう} means "heartless" or "unfeeling."
